The machine is relatively quiet, plays a nice tune once the cycle is finished. Once the load is complete and in between uses I noticed an unpleasant, sort of musty smell. Thought it might be due to the fact it was a new machine or perhaps the detergent I used but I still notice this smell after several uses and after trying a different detergent. Sentence (English): (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc.
Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고의 미디어 식기세척기 고급형 고민하지마세요 ] || ---------------- || (+)2주 넘게 실제 사용해 보니, 이전에 사용하던 타사 식세기와 비교했을때 트레이가 커서 그릇이나 냄비 후라이팬 등 넣고도 여유가 있습니다. 건조 부분은 확실히 차이가 있습니다. 예전제품은 열선이 있어서 고온으로 건조해서 물기가 많이 없는 반면, 이 제품은 온수세척 후 남아있는  열기와 자연 건조방식이라 물기는 남아있지만, 그만큼 전력 소모가 적기에, 전력효율은 예전 제품보다 훨씬 좋은 거 같네요^^ 로켓설치로 받은 물품입니다. 구매 시 많은 도움 되시길 바랍니다^^ 식기세척기를 사용한지 약 8년정도 됐는데요, 첫 입문은 6인용 식세기로 싱크대 상판위에 올려두고 쓰는 L* 디오스 제품을  아주 잘 사용했었습니다. 근데, 아이가 둘이 생기고 4인가족이 되어보니, 6인용은 늘 좀 크기가 아쉽다 라는 생각이 있었어요. 대신 허리를 숙이지 않아도 되는 점은 편했지만, 큰 냄비 등은 넣지 못한 아쉬움은 항상 있었습니다. 그러다가 아파트로 이사오면서 기존에 빌트인  되어있던 삼* 12인용 식기세척기를 그동안 쭉 사용했었습니다.(파세코제조OEM)  근데 언젠가 부터 도어문열림 에러코드가 나면서 문은 닫혀있는데, 문열림 표시가 나고 경고음이 발생하더라구요. 작동은 됐지만, 식기세척기가 돌아가는 동안 거짓말 보태서 거의 30번 정도는 경고음이 울렸다가 안울렸다 반복해서 식기세척기를 결국 바꿔야겠다고 마음 먹었습니다. 마침 좋은 기회로 이번에 새롭게 출시된 미디어 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 있었는데요, 10/6일에 오시기로 했었는데, 설치 부속품 문제로 계속 미뤄져서 오늘 10/19일에 설치를 완료 했습니다.  첫 통화에서 기존 식기세척기 철거 비용이 10만원이 있다고 하셔서 남편이 미리 철거를 다 해놨었구요.(남편도 현장직)  현관앞에 둔 기존 식세기는 무상으로 수거해 가셨습니다. 기사님이 세 분이나 오셨는데, 교육 중이라고 양해를 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 있었는데요, 10/6일에 오시기로 했었는데, 설치 부속품 문제로 계속 미뤄져서 오늘 10/19일에 설치를 완료 했습니다.  첫 통화에서 기존 식기세척기 철거 비용이 10만원이 있다고 하셔서 남편이 미리 철거를 다 해놨었구요.(남편도 현장직)  현관앞에 둔 기존 식세기는 무상으로 수거해 가셨습니다. 기사님이 세 분이나 오셨는데, 교육 중이라고 양해를 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Sentence (English): My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it.
Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

사용했었습니다.(파세코제조OEM)  근데 언젠가 부터 도어문열림 에러코드가 나면서 문은 닫혀있는데, 문열림 표시가 나고 경고음이 발생하더라구요. 작동은 됐지만, 식기세척기가 돌아가는 동안 거짓말 보태서 거의 30번 정도는 경고음이 울렸다가 안울렸다 반복해서 식기세척기를 결국 바꿔야겠다고 마음 먹었습니다. 마침 좋은 기회로 이번에 새롭게 출시된 미디어 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 있었는데요, 10/6일에 오시기로 했었는데, 설치 부속품 문제로 계속 미뤄져서 오늘 10/19일에 설치를 완료 했습니다.  첫 통화에서 기존 식기세척기 철거 비용이 10만원이 있다고 하셔서 남편이 미리 철거를 다 해놨었구요.(남편도 현장직)  현관앞에 둔 기존 식세기는 무상으로 수거해 가셨습니다. 기사님이 세 분이나 오셨는데, 교육 중이라고 양해를 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Sentence (English): Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly.
Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total.
