사용했었습니다.(파세코제조OEM)  근데 언젠가 부터 도어문열림 에러코드가 나면서 문은 닫혀있는데, 문열림 표시가 나고 경고음이 발생하더라구요. 작동은 됐지만, 식기세척기가 돌아가는 동안 거짓말 보태서 거의 30번 정도는 경고음이 울렸다가 안울렸다 반복해서 식기세척기를 결국 바꿔야겠다고 마음 먹었습니다. 마침 좋은 기회로 이번에 새롭게 출시된 미디어 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 있었는데요, 10/6일에 오시기로 했었는데, 설치 부속품 문제로 계속 미뤄져서 오늘 10/19일에 설치를 완료 했습니다.  첫 통화에서 기존 식기세척기 철거 비용이 10만원이 있다고 하셔서 남편이 미리 철거를 다 해놨었구요.(남편도 현장직)  현관앞에 둔 기존 식세기는 무상으로 수거해 가셨습니다. 기사님이 세 분이나 오셨는데, 교육 중이라고 양해를 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Sentence (English): Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total.
Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. 사용했었습니다.(파세코제조OEM)  근데 언젠가 부터 도어문열림 에러코드가 나면서 문은 닫혀있는데, 문열림 표시가 나고 경고음이 발생하더라구요. 작동은 됐지만, 식기세척기가 돌아가는 동안 거짓말 보태서 거의 30번 정도는 경고음이 울렸다가 안울렸다 반복해서 식기세척기를 결국 바꿔야겠다고 마음 먹었습니다. 마침 좋은 기회로 이번에 새롭게 출시된 미디어 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 있었는데요, 10/6일에 오시기로 했었는데, 설치 부속품 문제로 계속 미뤄져서 오늘 10/19일에 설치를 완료 했습니다.  첫 통화에서 기존 식기세척기 철거 비용이 10만원이 있다고 하셔서 남편이 미리 철거를 다 해놨었구요.(남편도 현장직)  현관앞에 둔 기존 식세기는 무상으로 수거해 가셨습니다. 기사님이 세 분이나 오셨는데, 교육 중이라고 양해를 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

사용했었습니다.(파세코제조OEM)  근데 언젠가 부터 도어문열림 에러코드가 나면서 문은 닫혀있는데, 문열림 표시가 나고 경고음이 발생하더라구요. 작동은 됐지만, 식기세척기가 돌아가는 동안 거짓말 보태서 거의 30번 정도는 경고음이 울렸다가 안울렸다 반복해서 식기세척기를 결국 바꿔야겠다고 마음 먹었습니다. 마침 좋은 기회로 이번에 새롭게 출시된 미디어 식기세척기 고급형 12인용을 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 그날 저희집은 축제 분위기였답니다^^ 미디어 가전 사용은 전 처음은 아니고 이미 저희집에  있는 건조기를 잘 사용하고 있는데요. 미디어는 중국제품이지만, 백색가전으로 유명하고 국내외 유명 가전회사들의 OEM과 ODM 된 제품들로 이미 성능을 인정받고 있는 회사입니다.  삼*의 비스포크 식기세척기도 이 미디어 회사 제품이 들어간다고 알려졌습니다.  또 무설치 식기세척기를 비교한 탤런트 하석진씨의 영상에서 브랜드만 보고 산 S*매직, 쿠*의 식기세척기도 모두 미디어 제품이었던 걸로 화제가 된 적도 있습니다^^ 그래서 믿고 쓰는 미디어 식기세척기인데요. 다만 이번에 주문 후 배송이 정말 오래걸렸습니다. 10/4일 주문 후 다음날 배송기사님 해피콜이 있었는데요, 10/6일에 오시기로 했었는데, 설치 부속품 문제로 계속 미뤄져서 오늘 10/19일에 설치를 완료 했습니다.  첫 통화에서 기존 식기세척기 철거 비용이 10만원이 있다고 하셔서 남편이 미리 철거를 다 해놨었구요.(남편도 현장직)  현관앞에 둔 기존 식세기는 무상으로 수거해 가셨습니다. 기사님이 세 분이나 오셨는데, 교육 중이라고 양해를 구하셨습니다. 설치시간은 1시간 정도 소요됐고 싱크대 밑에 걸레받이도 길이에 맞게 다 잘라서 체결해주셨습니다. 저희집은 기존에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있어서 자리나 공간은 딱 맞게 들어갔고, 걸레받이만 톱으로 잘라서 넣어주시는 시공이 들어가서 시공비는 0원으로 전혀 들지 않았습니다. 첫날 통화해서 철거비용 10만원은 얘기가 있었으나 남편이 철거를 해둬서 비용 발생은 없었고 로켓설치에 명시 되어있던 내용인 무상철거는 해주셨네요.  그래서 기존에 헌 삼*빌트인 식세기는 무사히 잘 가져가 주셨습니다. 이제 식기세척기 사용기로 넘어가 보겠습니다.  1. 문 개폐의 부드러움 먼저 기존 식세기랑 비교했을 때 문열고 닫음이 정말 부드럽네요 ㅠㅠ 이전 식세기는 제조년도 2005년이라 정말 오래됐는데요, 그 식세기는 문닫을때 엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 전체적으로 부드럽습니다. 3. 트레이 갯수 기존 12인용 세척기는 트레이가 2개였고 수저를 꽂는 방식인 수저통만 하나 있었는데, 이번에 받은 고급형 미디어 식기세척기 12인용은 맨 위쪽은 식기류 아래 2개의 트레이가 있어서 총 트레이는 3개입니다. 그리고 또 따로 수저를 꽂는 수저통이 하나더 있습니다. 다른점은 수저가 중간에 이탈하지 않도록 개폐방식의 상자 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. UV살균기능 기존 식세기는 열풍건조만을 내세워 UV살균 기능은 없었는데요, 이제품은 UV살균기능이 있습니다. 또 메뉴 조작버튼에서 기능을 켜고 끄고가 가능하네요^^ 5. 자동 문열림 기능 요즘 식기세척기들은 세척 후에 자동 문열림 기능이 거의 다 들어가 있는데요, 기존에 사용했던 식세기는 자동 문열림 기능이 없이 열풍 건조기능만 있고 문이 열리지 않았습니다.  그래서 식기세척기 하단부에 열선이 있었는데 매우 고온으로 위험하기도 했고 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 외출이라도 하고 돌아와서 문을 열면 물기가 마르지도 않고 오히려 안에 수증기가 응축된 물이 많이 남아 있는 경우가 많았습니다. 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 안심하고 외출할 수 있어서 좋습니다. 6. 세척력 향상 세척날개에 2개의 회전축을 사용해서 720도 물 분사로 사각지대 없이 세척된다고 하네요. 또 75도의 고온수로 헹굼을 해줘서 깨끗하게 그릇 세척이 가능합니다. 7. 상하 트레이 분리세척기능 이 기능은 깜짝 놀랐는데요, 식기가 많지 많을때나 냄비만 씻고 싶을때가 있는데, 이때 위 아래 트레이 분리 세척이 가능하네요. 그래서 위쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동하거나 아래쪽만 물이 나오게 해서 작동이 가능합니다. 이 기능은 물절약이 가능해서 참 좋은거 같네요. 정말 좋은 제품 만나게 돼서 기쁘고 식기세척기 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같네요.  미디어 가전 고민이신 분들 성능 고민 말고 선택하시면 될 것 같습니다. 기사님들 매우 친절하시고 안전하고 깔끔하게 설치해 주시고 가셨네요. 구매하시려는 분들께 꼭 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다. 감사합니다^^!!

Sentence (English): The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly.
Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

엄청 힘을 줘서(제 체중을 실어서 닫을정도) 닫아야 했고 문을 열때도 밑에 누름 버튼을 힘껏 눌러야 했습니다.  근데 이 미디어 식기세척기는 아주 부드럽게 닫히고 열때도 그냥 가볍게 당겨주면 잘 열리네요. 2, 소음 기존 식기세척기는 소음이 꽤 많았습니다. 시작하면 물 받아서 돌아갈때 소리가 좀 컸는데, 미디어 식기세척기는 소음이 많이 없는 편이네요. 모양이고 꽂아서 잘 빠지지 않도록 한 점이 세심함이 느껴지네요. 4. Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate to get the best value for your money media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (+) After using it for over 2 weeks, compared to the dishwasher of another company that I used before, the tray is bigger, so there is room to put dishes, pots, frying pans, etc. There is definitely a difference in the drying part. The old product had a heating element, so it dried at a high temperature and did not have much moisture, whereas this product uses the remaining heat after washing in hot water and dries naturally, so moisture remains, but it consumes less power, so the power efficiency seems to be much better than the old product^^ This is an item I received through Rocket Installation. I hope it will be helpful when purchasing^^ It has been about 8 years since I started using a dishwasher, and my first dishwasher was a 6-person dishwasher, an L* Dios product that I used on the sink top, and it worked very well. However, after having two children and becoming a family of 4, I always thought that the 6-person one was a bit too small. On the other hand, it was convenient that I didn't have to bend over, but I always regretted not being able to put in large pots. Then, when I moved into an apartment, I had been using the built-in Sam* 12-person dishwasher (Paseco OEM). But one day, the door-opening error code came on, and the door was closed, but the door-opening sign came on and the alarm sounded. It worked, but while the dishwasher was running, it kept beeping and not beeping about 30 times, so I decided to replace the dishwasher. By chance, I was able to use the newly released Media 12-person high-end dishwasher. That day, my house was in a festive mood^^ It was not my first time using Media appliances, and I was already using the dryer in my house well. Media is a Chinese product, but it is famous for white goods and is a company that has already been recognized for its performance as an OEM and ODM for famous domestic and foreign home appliance companies. It is known that Sam*'s bespoke dishwasher also uses Media's products. Also, in a video comparing dishwashers without installation, it became a hot topic that even S*Magic and Ku* dishwashers that were purchased just for the brand were all Media products^^ That's why I trust and use Media dishwashers. However, this time, the delivery took a really long time after ordering. After ordering on 10/4, the delivery person called me the next day, and he was supposed to come on 10/6, but it was postponed due to issues with the installation parts, so the installation was completed today, 10/19. In the first call, he said that the cost of removing the existing dishwasher was 100,000 won, so my husband had already removed it (he also works on-site). He collected the old dishwasher that was left in front of the entrance for free. Three delivery people came, but they asked for my understanding because they were in the middle of training. The installation took about an hour, and the mop holder under the sink was cut to the right length and attached. My house already had a built-in dishwasher, so the space and space fit perfectly, and the construction cost was 0 won because they cut the mop holder with a saw and installed it. On the first day, we talked about a demolition cost of 100,000 won, but my husband already did the demolition, so there was no cost, and they did the demolition free of charge as stated in the Rocket Installation. So, they safely took my old Sam* built-in dishwasher. Now, let's move on to the dishwasher usage review. 1. Smooth door opening and closing First, compared to the existing dishwasher, the door opens and closes really smoothly. The previous dishwasher was manufactured in 2005, so it was really old. That dishwasher had to be closed with a lot of force (to the point of putting my body weight on it) to close the door, and I had to press the push button hard to open the door. But this media dishwasher closes very smoothly, and when opening, I just pull it lightly. 2. Noise The existing dishwasher was quite noisy. When I first started, it made a loud noise when it filled with water and turned, but the media dishwasher is not very noisy. It is smooth overall. 3. Number of trays The existing 12-person dishwasher had two trays and only one spoon holder for inserting cutlery, but the high-end 12-person media dishwasher I received this time has two trays under the cutlery at the very top, so there are three trays in total. And there is one more spoon holder for inserting cutlery separately. The difference is that it is box-shaped with an open/close method to prevent the spoon from falling out in the middle, and the attention to detail shows how well it is inserted so that it does not fall out easily. 4. UV sterilization function The existing dishwasher only boasted hot air drying and did not have a UV sterilization function, but this product has a UV sterilization function. You can also turn the function on and off using the menu operation button^^ 5. Automatic door opening function Most dishwashers these days have an automatic door opening function after washing, but the dishwasher I used before did not have an automatic door opening function and only had a hot air drying function, and the door did not open. So there was a heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher, but it was very hot and dangerous, and there was no automatic door opening function, so when I went out and came back and opened the door, the water did not dry, and instead, there were many cases where there was a lot of condensed water inside. It is good that I can go out with peace of mind because it has an automatic door opening function. 6. Improved cleaning power It is said that it washes without any blind spots with a 720-degree water spray using two rotating axes on the washing wing. It also rinses with 75-degree high-temperature water, so you can wash the dishes cleanly. 7. Upper and lower tray separation cleaning function This function surprised me. When there are a lot of dishes or when you only want to wash pots, you can separate the upper and lower trays and wash them. So you can operate it with water coming out only from the upper part or only from the lower part. This function is really good because it saves water. I am happy to have found such a good product, and I think I will continue to use the dishwasher well. If you are worried about media appliances, I think you can choose it without worrying about performance. The technicians were very kind and installed it safely and cleanly. I hope this will be helpful to those who are thinking about purchasing. Thank you^^!

It ended up being delivered on the scheduled day, but I spent the day prior expecting it to show up early.

Sentence (English): Generally a good device.
Comments (English): [ 3 steps forward, 1 step back ] || ---------------- || Generally a good device. I think it's a shame that the eco programs run longer and longer. Now around 4 hours. Before it was only 2.5 hours. Yes, there is a quick program with 1.5 hours but that is less energy efficient. I also don't think the touch buttons are ideal as they don't respond nearly as well as on a smartphone and therefore as expected. Why do you have to install touch if they are worse than buttons? I liked the flat and perfectly functioning buttons on the predecessor better. I also miss the option to set WHEN the door should be opened. Immediately after the program ends is too early for me because of the steam. But when we go on vacation the door should open after about 1-2 hours. Or why can't I open the door using the app? Technically it should work, it's just that Bosch didn't take this into account.
Comments (Original): [ 3 Schritte vor, 1 zurück ] || ---------------- || Allgemein gutes Gerät. Ich finde es schade dass die Eco Programme immer länger laufen. Inzwischen um die 4 Stunden. Davor waren es nur 2.5h. Ja es gibt ein schnelles Programm mit 1.5h aber das ist weniger Energieeffizient. Ich finde die Touch Tasten auch nicht optimal, da sie nicht annähernd so gut reagieren wie am Smartphone und somit eigentlich erwartet. Warum muss man Touch einbauen wenn sie schlechter sind als Tasten? Ich fand die flache und perfekt funktionierende Tasten beim Vorgänger besser.Mir fehlt auch die Option einzustellen WANN die Tür geöffnet werden soll. Direkt nach Programmende ist für mich zu früh wegen Dampf. Aber wenn wir in den Urlaub fahren soll die Tür doch bitte aufgehen nach ca 1-2h. Oder warum kann ich die Tür nicht durch die App öffnen? Das sollte technisch funktionieren, ist nur nicht von Bosch bedacht.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is 100% worth the money.
Comments (English): [ Best purchase we've ever made ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is 100% worth the money. I read into the reviews on this website and was nervous to make it because so many people had complaints. If you're THAT tired of doing dishes, none of these complaints will really bother you. It's super easy to hook up and get started. We did have to buy a whole new faucet because somehow there was not a thread to match our sink ever made so we purchased a new faucet to accommodate the thread to the dishwasher and it's worked wonderful. Yes, you can't tell how long you have left on your load due to the controls being on the top of the door, but it really doesn't matter. You will know when it turns off, and you can see the time through the little crack where it's closed if you just bend down to look. It rolls easily but is very heavy so be sure you have a good grip on it while rolling it. My dishes come out clean, it always smells so clean and sanitized after a load. It doesn't have a drying option but like I've said before, you'll know when the load is finished so just do your dishes in the evening and open the door to let it dry overnight. JUST BUY IT. these reviews will make you paranoid but trust me when I say it works wonderfully and worth it.

The Zeolite drying feature works well on the dishes but not so well on plastic containers. The filter is easly accessible for frequent cleaning. The utensil top rack works well and the utensil basket is not needed further expanding the capacity of the unit to clean more dishes, pots, glasses,. Love the unit but it was 2-3x the price to the most mass market brand dishwashers.

Sentence (English): We absolutely love this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Runs quiet like whisper, powerful wash and air-dry, smart functions with the app ] || ---------------- || We absolutely love this dishwasher! It has many features that we didn't know we needed until we experienced them ourselves! First, it runs very quietly. If your kitchen is close to the living room like ours, this may become important. In our previous dishwasher that came with the house, we would have to speak louder while we were hanging out in the living room or it would take over any conversation, the sounds from TV or music players, and pretty much would become the loudest family member in the room. With this LG dishwasher, we can run the machine after dinner and can still hang out in the living room, have a conversation or watch a movie. You can't even tell it's working during quiet scenes. Second, the dynamic heat drying works like a charm using air instead of a hot element at the bottom of the machine. I learned my lesson by burning my hand on that element back in the day. Dishes come out dry and shining with no water spots. Also, the drying doesn't burn like inferno and we can wash kids' plastic plates, cups, and they come out intact, not melted into slime. It has a few drying options including night dry, and dry boost, and they all worked great for our purposes. Third, the racks are well designed so that dishes don't fall to the bottom, stopping the spraying arms. Plates fit well with good space between the slots, and you can use larger spaces for larger dishes. Every corner of the racks gets good water and water pressure so that there are no dead zones in which dishes would not get cleaned. Fourth, it works with wi-fi and the LG thin-q app (easy to add and use) that sends you a notification when a cycle is over. My favorite notification is when it tells you that rinse-aid is low and needs to be refilled. Otherwise, I used to play by ear and fill it until it overflowed. The cycle we use in the evenings is about 2 hours and 50 minutes, but it also has a one-hour wash and dry fast cycle when you are in a hurry. Overall, this is a well-designed and powerful dishwasher that we are hoping to use many years to come.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher cleans and dries dishes wonderfully.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, horrible delivery/install ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher cleans and dries dishes wonderfully. The controls are basic, but all I wanted was a dishwasher that really cleans and dries well. I would give this purchase experience a "5" except the third party delivery/install company that Costco used is just awful. My delivery was rescheduled 3 times including a cancellation on the same day the dishwasher was scheduled to be delivered. Also, no tarps were put down on my flooring as they removed the old dishwasher and put in the new dishwasher. In addition, they installed the drainage hose and water hoses with kinks in them and I had them redo them and straighten them out. They wrapped the water hoses around the sprayer hose as well, which I had them redo. Also left a big mess with the packaging Styrofoam that I had to clean after they were done. I contacted Costco customer service and they were apologetic. I told them the the delivery/install portion of this transaction is definitely a weak spot which needs to be addressed.

I have had some cups used for mixing flour for thickeners and this has not cleaned them.Dishes are usually pretty wet even with a drying cycle. Some of my glasses have a pretty large rim on the bottom, and while they used to get dry with the other washer, they stay wet in this one. I have a water softener but sometimes the water leaves pretty big spots and sometimes it is cloudy after washing, like those cups with the rim on the base.I have not tried the Wifi or other connections on the washer. The controls are pretty intuitive but it does need to be turned on before changing a setting.

Sentence (English): We have had a number of dishwashers, of various manufacturer's, and all claimed to be quiet & efficient.
Comments (English): [ Forgot we ran it.  ] || ---------------- || We have had a number of dishwashers, of various manufacturer's, and all claimed to be quiet & efficient. Well, after many discussions with her friends, my wife * I decided we needed a more quiet machine. Her friends reccommended Bosch. One of their quotes was "if the light wasn't on, we wouldn't know it was running". I myself decided to download a Decibel meter onto my to check our current machine. 38-43 dbs. But I have to say, didn't seem like that. So we looked at a number of washers and based on my wife's friends comments, picked Bosch. Decided on the 500 series, since the 800 was considerably more, and we didn't need all the bells and whistles that offered. But we did like the layout of the racks, and having 3, especially the flatware tray on top is my favorite. It leaves the flatware cleaner than the basket, in my opinion. But the best part, is that it is truely the quietest dishwasher we have owned, and very happy with our choise. And regarding the Dbs, when tested with the same app, at or below 28 dbs, or quiet, on the meter. And such sometimes now, "we forgot we ran it". Thank you Bosch for the quiet engineered into this machine.

Sentence (English): We are very disappointed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ The dishwasher cleans poorly. Despite technical ] || ---------------- || We are very disappointed with this dishwasher. It does not clean the dishes thoroughly, and glasses in particular often remain dirty. Despite two visits from a technician who explained to us that we were loading the dishwasher incorrectly and using the wrong detergent, nothing has improved. We were advised to use cheap detergent because the machine already contains salt and rinse aid, but that did not help. We have given up and sometimes wash the dishes twice. The technician also said that we should not use the EU Eco program because it does not clean properly - this is completely incomprehensible because we bought the machine precisely because of its energy efficiency. Our old Bosch dishwasher cleaned much better with the same load and the same detergent. Overall, we are very dissatisfied with this dishwasher and cannot recommend it.
Comments (Original): [ Die Spülmaschine reinigt schlecht. Trotz technisch ] || ---------------- || Wir sind sehr enttäuscht von dieser Spülmaschine. Sie reinigt das Geschirr nicht gründlich, besonders Gläser bleiben oft schmutzig. Trotz zweimaligem Besuch eines Technikers, der uns erklärte, dass wir die Spülmaschine falsch beladen und das falsche Waschmittel verwenden, hat sich nichts verbessert. Uns wurde geraten, billiges Waschmittel zu verwenden, da bereits Salz und Klarspüler in der Maschine vorhanden sind, aber das hat nicht geholfen. Wir haben resigniert und waschen teilweise das Geschirr doppelt.  Der Techniker meinte auch, dass wir das EU Eco-Programm nicht nutzen sollten, weil es nicht richtig sauber macht – das ist völlig unverständlich, da wir die Maschine gerade wegen ihrer Energieeffizienz gekauft haben.Unsere alte Spülmaschine von Bosch hat mit derselben Beladung und demselben Waschmittel deutlich besser gereinigt. Insgesamt sind wir sehr unzufrieden mit dieser Spülmaschine und können sie nicht empfehlen.

While the third rack is nice, it makes the other 2 racks sit lower. Meaning you have to stoop lower to load the racks. It's a back killer for someone like me. Difficult to load the 2 lower racks, the configuration makes little sense and hard to figure out where/how to place the dishes. I watched the loading video and it was of little use. Most of my dishwasher need is for cups and glasses, occasional pot and skillets. Nearly impossible to load a &10” skillet on the lower rack. And the recommendation is to not load glassware on the lower rack. Glasses don't stand up on lower rack and can be damaged. If you have a lot of plates the lower rack should work just fine.On a positive note, the noise level is superb and the cleaning of dishes is satisfactory. I do wish there was a heated dry option like I had on my old Maytag.

Comments (English): [ Stopped working after only four years! ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher along with the entire tuscan appliance set in 2020 during a kitchen remodel (the tuscan dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator and stove - spent a lot of money for this entire set but we wanted all new appliances that all matched for our new kitchen) and already this dishwasher is not cleaning the dishes on the bottom shelf. We have tried everything to everything to get it to clean the dishes on the bottom shelf. Cleaned the filter, positioned the dishes in the direction that the owners manual instructed and set the power on different washing levels to see if that made any difference. Nothing has changed. The only way our dishes get clean is by placing them all on the top basket and not on the bottom. This is very frustrating considering this dish washer is only four years old. Our other dishwasher which was a different brand lasted way longer than this Samsung. We had no issues with it, but we got rid of it since we wanted all of our new appliances to match in the tuscan color for our new kitchen. That is now a regret. The whole experience with the Samsung appliances have not been going well at all these last four years of having them. Started out having the stove completely stop working after only having it less than a year and luckily it was still under warranty and they replace the stove. And then after a couple years of having the refrigerator, the icemaker decided to stop working. We follow the directions of how to fix the icemaker since so many people have had the same issue so it said to use a hairdryer on it and that only worked for a day and it went right back to not working again and we had to keep getting the hairdryer back out. So stupid that we have to use a hairdryer on our Samsung refrigerator icemaker. This is ridiculous Samsung! You are making a poor product and stealing customers money! And now for several months, our refrigerator is making an extremely annoying noise that will not stop no matter what we do to it. The only appliance from the Samsung Tuscan set that we bought that actually hasn't caused problems is the microwave. And after the stove was replaced we have not had any issues with the stove since. Sentence (English): This is my first dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ This is my first time using a dishwasher. I wonder if it really cleans as well as I've heard. ] || ---------------- || This is my first dishwasher. It's great because it's linked to my phone and an alarm goes off~ My husband and I always tell each other that it was a good purchase after the dryer. Don't worry and try it once~~ It's so much more convenient! I really like it.

This one is a little thinner in construction. The controls are good, but quick washes really don't work well. I always use Finish Quantum Pods but in this dishwasher it needs a full high temperature wash or things really won't get clean. Sometimes, even with all of that, dishes come out not clean. It generally doesn't do a good soak; dishes that have caked on flour for example probably need to be soaked prior to washing. I have had some cups used for mixing flour for thickeners and this has not cleaned them. Dishes are usually pretty wet even with a drying cycle. Some of my glasses have a pretty large rim on the bottom, and while they used to get dry with the other washer, they stay wet in this one. I have a water softener but sometimes the water leaves pretty big spots and sometimes it is cloudy after washing, like those cups with the rim on the base. I have not tried the Wifi or other connections on the washer. The controls are pretty intuitive but it does need to be turned on before changing a setting.

Sentence (English): I have had this dishwasher for several years and the entire time I have had it, I have wished I had chosen something else.
Comments (English): [ Not worth it at all ] || ---------------- || I have had this dishwasher for several years and the entire time I have had it, I have wished I had chosen something else. Regardless of what detergent and rinse aid used (I favor Cascade but have used Finish as well and tried a couple other brands as well) there are times dishes that were not even all that dirty going in (drinking glasses that had iced coffee or tea in them for example) will come out dirty and I run them again and they're still dirty, I'll try a third time and give up and just hand wash to finally get them clean. The biggest problem however is that the door latch sensor is constantly malfunctioning. There seems to be no rhyme or reason to it. It'll work fine for weeks or months then randomly it refuses to latch/register that the door is latched. I've adjusted the door, the hinges, verified everything is connected properly and the unit is level etc but it still refuses to work properly. I'll give up and just hand wash dishes for a few weeks and out of desperation at some point I'll try the dishwasher again and like magic it will be working again no issues - lather rinse repeat. I should have done more research before buying this as apparently this is a common problem with GE dishwashers regardless of whether it's one of the budget models like this one or a higher end one. I grew up with GE being known for being a high quality brand you could trust so I didn't really look into it much before I made the purchase. Lesson learned. I'll never be buying another GE dishwasher again - possibly no other appliances either. So frustrating and disappointed.

Sentence (English): FIRE HAZARD -- Stay away from this LG Product.
Comments (English): [ FIRE HAZARD -- STAY AWAY FROM THIS UNIT ] || ---------------- || FIRE HAZARD -- Stay away from this LG Product. Unfortunately, I came to this site a little too late. I purchased this unit and within the first 4 months of ownership, we had multiple incidents of accidentally bumping the front knobs unintentionally turning on the unit. As others have described, the knobs are extremely sensitive. We had a fire in our kitchen that was quickly extinguished. On a separate occasion, the device was unintentionally turned on and damaged the cooktop making it unsafe to use. This seems to be a common theme with these LG units. Customer support is no help. Their only suggestion is to be more careful not to bump the knobs and use the "control lock" feature of the range. This is a fantastic idea, except the design flaw that a power outage defaults to the control lock feature being off. LG will not assist with fixing the 4 month old range with a 1 year warranty because a damaged cooktop is considered "cosmetic" even though it is not safe to cook on. It would be one thing if this was an isolated issue on our part, but to see numerous complaints with fires is a problem LG will not address. Thankfully, no one in our home was hurt by this defective product. Do not make the same mistake we did. Avoid LG!

Sentence (English): This is a one-week review.
Comments (English): [ Disadvantage 1. It's noisy. If you look inside the dishwasher, there is an upper wing, and the manual says to tighten it, but if you tighten it too much, it makes a loud noise. I think this is a design flaw. ] || ---------------- || This is a one-week review. Cons: 1. It's noisy. The dishwasher has a top flap, and the manual says to tighten it, but if you tighten it, it makes a "pop-pop" noise. I believe this is a design flaw, but Minix customer service says it's not a problem. If you listen closely to the review videos posted, you'll see a "pop-pop-pop" noise. It's not just me; other people's videos have this noise, so it seems to be a common occurrence these days. If you look closely at the reviews, people say the noise is very loud, but I believe most people are complaining about this noise. It's incredibly noisy. There's a workaround: don't tighten the top flap completely, but tighten it slightly. This will allow water to drip from the flap, but the noise will be significantly reduced. However, the "pop-pop" noise still persists, so I just remove the top flap and use it. This is more convenient. 2. The water supply is inconvenient, and you can't add a rinse cycle. This is a subtle problem. Minix dishwashers are marketed as having a water tank underneath the unit, eliminating the need for a separate water line. However, because the water tank capacity is physically limited, adding additional rinse cycles is physically impossible. I don't know about other factors, but if you set it to Quick or Standard, it will fill water and wash three times. The problem is that if you use too much detergent, it can remain on the dishes. This can cause a fishy smell. To solve this problem, you need to always add a small amount of detergent, but it's difficult to adjust the amount to exactly match the level of soiling and remove all the detergent in three washes. It would be easier to choose between 4 and 5 rinse cycles, but due to the physical limitations of the water tank, that setting isn't included. It's also difficult to adjust the detergent amount, and if too much detergent is added, it can remain on the dishes, causing a fishy smell. And filling the water tank takes a surprisingly long time. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. This washes the dishes six times, which is great because it doesn't leave detergent residue or a fishy smell. 3. Miscellaneous. The interior is plastic. I didn't realize it when I bought it, but it still smells a bit plastic after washing. High-frequency noises can sometimes be heard in certain environments. The capacity is small. This is also inconvenient, so I wish I had bought the 6-person model instead. It's a size that makes it seem like it might be better to use a dishwasher or wash dishes. It's a bit ambiguous. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Anyway, after using it for a week, the biggest drawbacks of the Minix dishwasher are the inconvenient water supply, the inability to add additional rinse cycles, and the extreme noise. I won't be buying it again.

This can cause a fishy smell. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Anyway, after using it for a week, the biggest drawbacks of the Minix dishwasher are the inconvenient water supply, the inability to add additional rinse cycles, and the extreme noise. However, because the water tank capacity is physically limited, adding additional rinse cycles is physically impossible. I don't know about other factors, but if you set it to Quick or Standard, it will fill water and wash three times. The problem is that if you use too much detergent, it can remain on the dishes. This can cause a fishy smell. To solve this problem, you need to always add a small amount of detergent, but it's difficult to adjust the amount to exactly match the level of soiling and remove all the detergent in three washes. It's also difficult to adjust the detergent amount, and if too much detergent is added, it can remain on the dishes, causing a fishy smell. And filling the water tank takes a surprisingly long time. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. This washes the dishes six times, which is great because it doesn't leave detergent residue or a fishy smell. 3. Miscellaneous. The interior is plastic. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Anyway, after using it for a week, the biggest drawbacks of the Minix dishwasher are the inconvenient water supply, the inability to add additional rinse cycles, and the extreme noise. It's not just me; other people's videos have this noise, so it seems to be a common occurrence these days. If you look closely at the reviews, people say the noise is very loud, but I believe most people are complaining about this noise. It's incredibly noisy. There's a workaround: don't tighten the top flap completely, but tighten it slightly. This will allow water to drip from the flap, but the noise will be significantly reduced. However, the "pop-pop" noise still persists, so I just remove the top flap and use it. This is more convenient. 2. The water supply is inconvenient, and you can't add a rinse cycle. This is a subtle problem. Minix dishwashers are marketed as having a water tank underneath the unit, eliminating the need for a separate water line. However, because the water tank capacity is physically limited, adding additional rinse cycles is physically impossible. I don't know about other factors, but if you set it to Quick or Standard, it will fill water and wash three times. The problem is that if you use too much detergent, it can remain on the dishes. This can cause a fishy smell. To solve this problem, you need to always add a small amount of detergent, but it's difficult to adjust the amount to exactly match the level of soiling and remove all the detergent in three washes. It would be easier to choose between 4 and 5 rinse cycles, but due to the physical limitations of the water tank, that setting isn't included. It's also difficult to adjust the detergent amount, and if too much detergent is added, it can remain on the dishes, causing a fishy smell. And filling the water tank takes a surprisingly long time. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. This washes the dishes six times, which is great because it doesn't leave detergent residue or a fishy smell. 3. Miscellaneous. The interior is plastic. I didn't realize it when I bought it, but it still smells a bit plastic after washing. High-frequency noises can sometimes be heard in certain environments. The capacity is small. This is also inconvenient, so I wish I had bought the 6-person model instead. It's a size that makes it seem like it might be better to use a dishwasher or wash dishes. It's a bit ambiguous. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Anyway, after using it for a week, the biggest drawbacks of the Minix dishwasher are the inconvenient water supply, the inability to add additional rinse cycles, and the extreme noise. I won't be buying it again.

This can cause a fishy smell. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. I won't be buying it again.

This can cause a fishy smell. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Anyway, after using it for a week, the biggest drawbacks of the Minix dishwasher are the inconvenient water supply, the inability to add additional rinse cycles, and the extreme noise. I won't be buying it again.

It's not just me; other people's videos have this noise, so it seems to be a common occurrence these days. If you look closely at the reviews, people say the noise is very loud, but I believe most people are complaining about this noise. It's incredibly noisy. There's a workaround: don't tighten the top flap completely, but tighten it slightly. This will allow water to drip from the flap, but the noise will be significantly reduced. However, the "pop-pop" noise still persists, so I just remove the top flap and use it. This is more convenient. 2. The water supply is inconvenient, and you can't add a rinse cycle. This is a subtle problem. Minix dishwashers are marketed as having a water tank underneath the unit, eliminating the need for a separate water line. However, because the water tank capacity is physically limited, adding additional rinse cycles is physically impossible. I don't know about other factors, but if you set it to Quick or Standard, it will fill water and wash three times. The problem is that if you use too much detergent, it can remain on the dishes. This can cause a fishy smell. To solve this problem, you need to always add a small amount of detergent, but it's difficult to adjust the amount to exactly match the level of soiling and remove all the detergent in three washes. It would be easier to choose between 4 and 5 rinse cycles, but due to the physical limitations of the water tank, that setting isn't included. It's also difficult to adjust the detergent amount, and if too much detergent is added, it can remain on the dishes, causing a fishy smell. And filling the water tank takes a surprisingly long time. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. This washes the dishes six times, which is great because it doesn't leave detergent residue or a fishy smell. 3. Miscellaneous. The interior is plastic. I didn't realize it when I bought it, but it still smells a bit plastic after washing. High-frequency noises can sometimes be heard in certain environments. The capacity is small. This is also inconvenient, so I wish I had bought the 6-person model instead. It's a size that makes it seem like it might be better to use a dishwasher or wash dishes. It's a bit ambiguous. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Anyway, after using it for a week, the biggest drawbacks of the Minix dishwasher are the inconvenient water supply, the inability to add additional rinse cycles, and the extreme noise. I won't be buying it again.

I won't be buying it again.

This can cause a fishy smell. However, because the water tank capacity is physically limited, adding additional rinse cycles is physically impossible. I don't know about other factors, but if you set it to Quick or Standard, it will fill water and wash three times. The problem is that if you use too much detergent, it can remain on the dishes. This can cause a fishy smell. It was so inconvenient that I just bought a 7L tank and connected the water supply to it. This is much more convenient. And instead of running it on standard, I run it on high speed twice. I'd rather have the 6-person model. Pros: It's dishwasher-safe, so I don't have to wash dishes. That's it. Sentence (English): This dishwasher is impressive.
Comments (English): [ Sleek and Quiet ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is impressive. First and foremost, it is a nice looking piece of hardware. The hidden control panel and large pull down handle are stylish features on the outside. As far as the inside goes, this thing holds A LOT of dishes. The 3rd row rack on the top will take some getting used to. I'm so used to dealing with 2 racks! The bottom rack is nicely designed to hold large plates or serving dishes as tines fold down. The jets under the utensil caddy ensure all of your forks, knives, and spoons get cleaned and sanitized, and the bottle jets on the middle rack are just what we needed to clean the inside of sports bottles. The bottle caps fit on the 3rd row but just barely. Large tumbler lids will not fit on the 3rd row. The middle rack can also be adjusted if you have really large items going on the bottom row. GE has an app that you can download and registering to use it was a bit of a pain. After downloading it, it asked me for my email and desired password. I entered the information and kept getting a red message saying to "try again later". I tried the next day and kept having the issue, so I reached out to GE. It turns out that certain keyboard characters do not work for passwords (which isn't mentioned in the password guidelines). After that, I was able to sign up to create an account. The dishwasher hooked up to my WI-FI without issue and there were a few software updates to install. There's not much to the app, but it allows you to remote start your dishwasher and sends an alert to your phone when its finished running its cycle. You can also enter the amount of dishwasher pods you currently have so it can send you a reminder when you're running low. Total energy consumption is another feature of the app. While this has nothing to do with the dishwasher itself, the delivery/install did not go smoothly. My original email said it would be delivered on a Thursday. That was the date I selected at the time the order was placed. 2 days after placing the order, I got an email and text from the install team saying there was some kind of glitch in the scheduling system and they were moving my delivery/install to Saturday. The email said to reply to it with any questions or issues and there was a cell phone number included it in it. Saturday was not convenient as I had other plans that day so I replied asking if it could be delivered a day early, on Friday. I did not get a reply. I tried calling and that too was unsuccessful. I contacted Costco customer care who was also unable to get in touch with the installer. The order confirmation said I would receive an automated phone call the night before the delivery and I got no such call so I had no idea what to anticipate for that Saturdays delivery. I get a call/text at 8:15AM on Saturday morning from the installer saying they would show up with the dishwasher in about 20 minutes. I was asleep at the time they called and didn't get a chance to answer but they also texted saying they were on the way and I was lucky I woke up and saw the text in time. That didn't leave me with much time to prepare but the install ended up going seamlessly. Overall experience. great dishwasher with a ton of great features. Costco delivery/communication needs a good bit of work.

The email said to reply to it with any questions or issues and there was a cell phone number included it in it. Saturday was not convenient as I had other plans that day so I replied asking if it could be delivered a day early, on Friday. I did not get a reply. I tried calling and that too was unsuccessful. The order confirmation said I would receive an automated phone call the night before the delivery and I got no such call so I had no idea what to anticipate for that Saturdays delivery. I get a call/text at 8:15AM on Saturday morning from the installer saying they would show up with the dishwasher in about 20 minutes. I was asleep at the time they called and didn't get a chance to answer but they also texted saying they were on the way and I was lucky I woke up and saw the text in time. Sentence (English): This LG dishwasher's brushed stainless exterior looks nice with our other kitchen appliances.
Comments (English): [ LG Stainless Steel Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This LG dishwasher's brushed stainless exterior looks nice with our other kitchen appliances. The stainless steel interior is good. It has three racks, but we find that the top rack for flatware we don't use that much, prefer to use the silverware basket on the bottom rack as it can be picked up and taken out to empty. The middle rack has two positions (high or low). The main bottom rack rolls in/out easily. Rack tine placement on the main rack does not seem to be close enough, and there are very few adjustable tines that could be moved for placement of larger or smaller items. The dishwasher does clean well. We have had a couple runs where the dish washer soap did not fully dispense even though the soap door did fully open. The controls are on the top of the door, so not visible when running, but there is a lighted countdown timer visible on the front of the door when it is running. The door feels very light, but does close with an audible click The dishwasher is very quiet which is really nice. The dishwasher plays a tune when the run is done, but we turned that option off. This is a “smart” dishwasher, and the LG ThinQ app… you (in theory) can remotely start the dishwasher, but you have had to remember to press the right buttons on the dishwasher to enable that feature. The app does alert you when the dishwasher completes, and alerts you when rinse aid needs to be added. One thing we did not realize we would miss, our previous dishwasher had an external handle that you could hang a towel on. This dishwasher's door handle is not that type.

I hope this helps those in the same situation as me! ^^
